guide: Never choose a pin. If the message does not say which pin, ask. Pins 0 and 1 are the USB connection; never use them for a part.
An LED needs a named pin constant at the top, pinMode(PIN, OUTPUT) in setup(), and digitalWrite in loop(). Wire it through a 220 ohm resistor, and add a row to the Connections table in wiring.md.
report: I added the $led on pin $pin ($name) -- it $how. wiring.md says how to connect it, and it needs a 220 ohm resistor.
The $led is on pin $pin now and $how. Check wiring.md before you plug it in: it goes through a resistor.
$name is pin $pin, and the $led $how. The wiring, resistor included, is in wiring.md.
teach: pinMode(..., OUTPUT) tells the board this pin sends power out; digitalWrite HIGH turns it on and LOW turns it off.
